SERVICE BOUNDARIES

Clear about what ORVIA is not.

ORVIA is not a police force, regulator, court, law firm or intelligence agency. ORVIA does not conduct unlawful surveillance, provide unauthorised system access or replace regulated professional judgement.

ORVIA does not make automated findings of guilt, safeguarding responsibility, clinical causation or legal liability.
